feedback: The confession follows the strongest available contradiction: Barb acknowledges removing camera power and inventing the prospect of local footage. Her admitted private-room check and control of privacy make the method coherent. Taking poison during the preview is newly confessed detail, but it is not a new decisive clue needed to identify her; the bottle's accessibility and contamination were already established. I found the ending earned logically and moderately satisfying emotionally. The closing concern about her department's trust fits her security role, though the confession could carry a little more of her personal fear of Grant. Chip and Brie's denials tie back to retained evidence and end with credible practical concerns rather than celebratory vindication.
